callbacks.onTrade: authenticated completed native trade; actual actor receives a backed credit
callbacks.onAction: authenticated direct transaction sender; expected per-launch actor nonce plus deadline

budget.funding: explicit moduleFunding at launch or vault.fund(instanceId)
budget.spendAuthority: runtime.credit to the active program instance only
budget.insufficient: skip reward permanently; no debt and no trade veto
budget.afterExpiry: only available budget becomes a refund-wallet claim; winner claims are unchanged
budget.lateFunding: anyone can fund; after expiry the fixed refund wallet can reclaim that funding too

reclaim-unused.callTarget: host runtime resolved from the admitted instance binding
reclaim-unused.effect: move available instance budget to claimable(instanceId,refundWallet)

hostComponents.runtime: existing host binding, never redeploy from the submitted runtime test source
hostComponents.vault: runtime.vault(), checked against the released host

commonManagement.claimTo: vault.claimTo(instanceId,recipient), beneficiary can redirect only its own claim
commonManagement.authority: the program cannot change common host action permissions

upgrades: none; source revisions create separately reviewed packages and new instances
reviewEnvelope: all valid configurations accepted by the pinned factory, not a narrower metadata-only range
